name: dh-stage-plates
look: Documentary, monochrome, real place, real light. Composition top-weighted: subject in the upper two thirds, lower third falls into deep unlit shadow and plain surface with no detail. Cinestill 35mm grain and halation. Nothing tack-sharp.

jobs.scene: Late afternoon light across an unmade bed and a folded towel. Nothing clinical. Stillness, not effort.
A clinician's desk from above: an open notebook, a pen, a laptop closed. Quiet, considered, mid-review.
A hand resting on a kitchen counter beside a glass of water in soft morning light. Calm and domestic.
An office stairwell at midday, empty, hard daylight through a high window.
A clean pale worktop, a closed laptop and a single glass of water, shot straight down.
A woman in her forties standing at a window with a mug, seen from behind in flat morning light.
A well-worn training shoe on a gym floor at dawn, heel compressed on one edge.
A chalk-dusted bench and a closed notebook under a high window, nobody in frame.
A man in his forties lacing a shoe on a bench, face out of frame, low side light.
